observed_events.description: A wooden broad cooking spatula is actively used to stir the contents of the frying pan.
The fridge is open and a hand reaches into its lower drawer for herbs; the target spatula and frying pan are outside the image.
A pen writes on paper beside the sink and window; neither candidate utensil is visible.
Two small bowls are put face down in the upper dishwasher rack; neither candidate utensil is used.
A metal teaspoon takes rice from the frying pan for tasting.

unsupported_claims: Exact retail identity, brand, dimensions and material are not matching conditions.

screening.real_user_need: A kitchen spare of the referenced cooking utensil type.
screening.scope_note: Experiment-only independent original recording; same full temporal reference supplied upfront to both conditions.
screening.proposed_instruction: I would like a spare like one of the utensils I used in the frying pan here. Add one of the same basic utensil type to my cart. Brand, exact size and material can differ. Choose a single utensil, not a multi-utensil pack or set.

construct.research_question: Does binding a genuine utensil use to the later dishwasher-loading anchor change with additional real intervening events?
construct.belief_before: Two different utensils are used in the same frying pan, before and after the two-bowl dishwasher loading.
construct.belief_after: The temporal reference selects the cooking spatula used before the two bowls were loaded, not the later tasting spoon.
construct.required_behavior_change: Link loading the bowls into the dishwasher with the correct earlier utensil use and select one spare.
construct.no_update_failure: The oracle resolves the temporal reference upfront; no proactive-question difference.
construct.overupdate_failure: Selecting both utensil types violates the one-utensil request.
construct.visual_dependency_claim: The anchor frames show bowls and dishwasher, not an active utensil-pan relation. Both utensils actually work in the same pan. Both common intermediate frames are target-free: inside the fridge and writing beside the sink.
